title: Adesh Package Manifest (ADL)
description: JSON Schema for Adesh Package Manifest (ADL) files — the adesh.adl project manifest. ADL is a TOML-like package manifest format for the Adesh programming language. It consists of optional [project], [compiler], [dependencies], [scripts] and [workspace] sections plus top-level import statements and if/else conditional blocks.

semver.description: Semantic version in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH form (e.g. "0.1.0"), optionally with pre-release or build metadata.
semver.errorMessage: Value must be a valid semantic version such as "0.1.0" (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, optionally with pre-release or build metadata).

versionRequirement.description: Version requirement for a dependency, e.g. "^1.0.0", ">=2.0.0", "~1.2.3", "=1.0.0", "1.2.3" or "*".
versionRequirement.errorMessage: Version requirement must look like "^1.0.0", ">=2.0.0", "~1.2.3", "=1.2.3", "1.2.3" or "*".

projectSection.title: [project]
projectSection.description: Project metadata section. This section is required in every adesh.adl manifest and defines the project name, version, and template type.

name.description: The name of the project. Must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores.
name.errorMessage: Project name must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores.

template.description:
The project template type.
- app — executable application
- lib — reusable library
- workspace — multi-package workspace
- plugin — compiler plugin
- package — distributable package

libs.description: List of library names to link against (for native backends).

compilerSection.title: [compiler]
compilerSection.description: Compiler configuration section. Controls the compilation backend and the optimization level.

backend.description:
The compilation backend.
- interpreter — tree-walking interpreter (default)
- llvm — LLVM-based native compilation
- native — direct native code generation

opt-level.description:
Optimization level.
- debug — no optimizations, full debug info
- release — full optimizations, no debug info
- fast — fast compilation with basic optimizations

dependenciesSection.title: [dependencies]
dependenciesSection.description: Dependency declarations. Each key is a package name and the value is either a version requirement string (e.g. "^1.0.0", ">=2.0.0", "*") or an object describing the dependency source and location.

propertyNames.errorMessage: Dependency names must be valid identifiers: letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore.

oneOf.title: Version requirement
oneOf.description: Version requirement for the package, e.g. "^1.0.0", ">=2.0.0", "~1.2.3", or "*".
oneOf.errorMessage: Version requirement must look like "^1.0.0", ">=2.0.0", "~1.2.3", or "*".

oneOf.title: Source dependency
oneOf.description: Dependency resolved from a specific source kind (path, git, registry, local, or workspace) and a location.

source.description:
How the dependency is resolved.
- path — resolve from a local filesystem path
- git — clone from a git repository
- registry — download from a named registry
- local — local path that is not published
- workspace — resolve from a workspace member
source.errorMessage: Dependency source must be one of: "path", "git", "registry", "local", "workspace".

location.description: The source location: a relative filesystem path for path/local/workspace sources, a git URL for git, or the registry name for registry (e.g. "official").

oneOf.errorMessage: A source-based dependency object must contain both "source" and "location".

additionalProperties.errorMessage: Dependency values must be a version requirement string (e.g. "^1.0.0") or an object with "source" and "location".

scriptsSection.title: [scripts]
scriptsSection.description: Named project scripts. Each entry is a binding of the form `const <name> = "<command>"` or `let <name> = "<command>"`. Use `const` for fixed scripts and `let` for parameterized scripts.

^(const|let) [a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$.description: The command executed by this script binding.

scriptsSection.$comment: ADL scripts use const/let bindings instead of plain keys; the pattern matches the full `const <name>` / `let <name>` binding form.

workspaceSection.title: [workspace]
workspaceSection.description: Workspace section for multi-package projects. Declares the paths of the workspace members.

members.description: Workspace member paths. Supports glob patterns such as "packages/*".

oneOf.description: Path of a single ADL manifest to import (e.g. "./shared.adl").
Paths of multiple ADL manifests to import.

importStatement.description: Import another ADL manifest file. ADL syntax: `import "./path/to/file.adl"`. May appear multiple times at the top level.

conditionalBlock.title: if condition { ... } else { ... }
conditionalBlock.description: Conditional configuration block. ADL syntax: `if <expr> { ... } else { ... }`. Conditions commonly test platform, target, or the debug flag, e.g. `if platform == "windows" { ... }`.

then.description: Configuration applied when the condition is true.

else.description: Configuration applied when the condition is false. Optional.

lockBlock.title: lock { }
lockBlock.description: Lockfile block, present in adesh.lock.adl files (not adesh.adl manifests). Locks the exact resolution of every dependency: version, checksum, and source. This schema validates lockfiles permissively so the *.adl mapping does not flag lock-only keys.

generated-at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp when the lockfile was generated, e.g. "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z".

compiler-version.description: Version of the Adesh compiler that generated this lockfile.

adl-version.description: Version of the ADL package manager that generated this lockfile.

package-id.description: Unique identifier of the package this lockfile belongs to.

dependencies.description: Locked dependency entries. Each entry records the exact resolved version, integrity checksums, and source for one dependency.

confidential.description: Sensitive key-value pairs (tokens, secrets) that are stripped from the published manifest.

signature.description: Integrity signature (FNV-1a hash) computed over all lockfile fields, used to detect tampering.

lockDependencyEntry.title: Locked dependency
lockDependencyEntry.description: A single locked dependency entry inside lock { dependencies = [ ... ] }.

package-id.description: Unique identifier for the dependency, typically `Name@version`.

version.description: The exact resolved version of the dependency.

requirement.description: The version requirement from the manifest that resolved to this version (e.g. "^1.0.0").

checksum.description: Short checksum (16 hex characters) for integrity verification.
checksum.errorMessage: checksum must be a hexadecimal string.

sha256.errorMessage: sha256 must be a hexadecimal string.

features.description: Feature flags enabled for this dependency.

registries.description: Registries consulted when resolving this dependency.

transitive.description: Transitive dependency IDs pulled in by this dependency.

target.description: Target platform triple (e.g. "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"). If absent, the dependency applies to all targets.

kind.description:
The source kind.
- registry — download from a named registry
- git — clone from a git URL
- path — resolve from a local filesystem path
- local — local path, not published
- workspace — resolve from a workspace member

location.description: The source location: a registry name ("official"), a git URL, or a filesystem path.
